issues.reason: Currency explanation preserves 오천 원=5000, 천=1000, 오천=5000 and won currency name. Complete Korean-token/numeric comparison passed after final authoring correction.

Younger sibling has no specified sex. Romanian uses persoana mai mică dintre frați or a relationship rewrite rather than choosing brother or sister. Meaning and unknown sex preserved; native educational fluency review recommended.

친구가 온다고 해요 makes friend the embedded coming subject, not automatically the reporter. Native wording keeps reporter impersonal. Parallel going distractor is treated the same way; no friend-gender or reporter-identity setting added.

English-only distractor glosses are compressed and may leave reporter/embedded participant or tense unresolved. Rendered as brief native propositions, without inventing a named referent or gender; canonical author clarification remains advisable.

authoringContext.existingPeople: Gender/number/referents remain as supplied or unspecified. Names and jobs are not gender evidence. Omitted Korean subjects are not newly assigned a named identity.
authoringContext.sourceLexicalKinship: Mother/grandmother/father/son/daughter gender is explicit lexical content. Speaker-woman older-sibling vocabulary is explicit only where source states it.
authoringContext.unknownSiblingsFriendsTeachers: Existing sibling/friend/teacher sex is unspecified; gender-neutral rewrites or generic grammatical forms do not create a semantic sex setting.
authoringContext.romanianGrammaticalGender: Generic prieten, cadru didactic and profession/animal nouns carry grammatical forms; no new character-sex setting follows from those forms.
authoringContext.politenessAndNumber: Romanian/Finnish formal address may use grammatical plural without asserting multiple addressees. No exact participant count invented.
